findings.summary: The text says catching Exception swallows Errors, but Exception does not catch Errors, because Error is a sibling branch under Throwable.
findings.evidence: "Catching Throwable or Exception swallows Errors and bugs"
findings.fix: Write: "Catching Throwable swallows Errors; catching Exception swallows bugs (RuntimeExceptions) along with recoverable failures. Catch the most specific type."

findings.summary: The Common Mistake bullet says catching Exception swallows Errors, which is wrong. Error sits under Throwable, not Exception, so a learner skimming would misread the hierarchy the page just showed.
findings.evidence: Catching Throwable or Exception swallows Errors and bugs
findings.fix: Write: 'Catching Throwable swallows Errors; catching Exception swallows bugs (RuntimeException)'.
